name: Objects
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Address actual objects and exact carried/ground/container copies, including collocated targets. Preserve material, size, mass/volume, fixed/attached state, HP/AC, thresholds, immunities, magical/worn/carried eligibility and exact contents. Manipulation, damage, destruction, repair and cleaning must change the selected copy; repair preserves identity and respects pieces, break dimensions and exclusions.

blockers: Use existing room/object and item-copy hosts; metadata is not proof every attack/spell/tool route executes. Unknown weight, volume, metal, magic or repair facts remain unknown. Mending is not resurrection, general HP refill or replacement loot.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
